summary: A Depth subscribe at 20 levels is refused as the web refuses it (5paisa streams 5 levels only), and nothing reaches 5paisa for it; the same instrument at 5 levels then subscribes.

notes: fivepaisa_adapter.py:411-414: mode 3 with depth_level not in [5] returns INVALID_DEPTH "Invalid depth level {depth_level}. 5Paisa only supports 5 levels" before any symbol lookup; server.py:1318-1335 answers the client a subscribe of status partial with the error item (symbol, exchange, status error, message, broker).

The glue refuses Depth at any level but 5 before storing anything, as the adapter's subscribe does, so web.json is computed: the web publishes nothing for the refused Depth 20; the Depth 5 subscribe that follows is the adapter's ordinary one.
